title: FS Imaging v1
description: Imaging, misfit, and image-condition configuration for imaging workflows.

observedSourceBasis.description: Basis used by observed data source ids. source_encoding means observed traces are already RHS-field gathers; source_geometry means observed traces are physical SourcePoint gathers and are encoded during misfit reads.

kind.description: Radial loss applied to each complex metric-weighted residual sample. Matching is case-insensitive at runtime.

delta.description: Positive Huber transition amplitude in data-metric coordinates.

c2.description: Positive Student-t squared scale in data-metric coordinates.

kind.description: Attribute compared before the radial objective is applied.

derivative_axis.description: Physical-frequency derivative axis; derivatives are with respect to Hz at fixed Laplace damping.

source_derivative.description: Whether authored source-signature and instrument spectra are held fixed or differentiated.

relative_amplitude_floor.description: Stabilization floor relative to the preprocessed observed RMS amplitude for each RHS/component.

receiverImpedance.description: Positive scalar impedance, one inline value per receiver, or a rank-one HDF5Dense receiver array.

kind.description: Canonical up_down projection, or the deprecated acoustic_upgoing compatibility spelling.

physics.description: Optional explicit reconstruction physics. Omit to infer acoustic from pressure/normal-velocity channels or elastic from complete velocity/vertical-traction channels plus shear_impedance.

tangential_velocity_components.description: Elastic tangential velocities; exactly NDIMEN-1 names are required.

tangential_traction_components.description: Elastic vertical-plane shear tractions paired with tangential velocities; exactly NDIMEN-1 names are required.

impedance.description: Acoustic or elastic P impedance used by the normal characteristic.

shear_impedance.description: Elastic S impedance used by tangential characteristics; required for elastic reconstruction.

name.description: Receiver group name to bind against the acquisition receiver group.

observed.description: Observed data path stem or trace-store descriptor.

df.description: Observed derivative with respect to physical frequency in Hz.

simulated.description: Simulated data path stem; omitted uses the receiver group's output file.

projection.description: Receiver-space projection applied before comparison and pulled back exactly into adjoint receiver loads.

kind.description: Built-ins include offset_power, offset_taper, source_scalar_fit, source_spectrum_correction, component_scale, trace_normalize, frequency_weight, trace_mask, trace_weight, receiver_ar1_whiten, scholte_notch, slow_velocity_mute, amplitude_clip, and wavefield_source_taper.

params.description: Hook-specific deterministic parameters. trace_weight accepts finite nonnegative weights and an explicit receiver, component_receiver, source_component_receiver, or sparse_trace layout; production arrays use an HDF5Dense reference while compact inline arrays remain supported. receiver_ar1_whiten accepts a finite correlation with absolute value below one and applies the exact stationary AR(1) inverse covariance factor along an ordered dense receiver axis. source_scalar_fit accepts norm (default inherit), max_iterations, relative_tolerance, and matching robust-loss parameters; n_irls is a deprecated max_iterations alias. source_spectrum_correction requires simulated stage plus complex scale and frequency_derivative arrays, each containing one broadcast value or global per-RHS values; complex entries are [real, imaginary] pairs and the derivative is with respect to physical Hz. scholte_notch accepts exactly one of phase_velocity or angular wavenumber plus relative_half_width, relative_taper_width, spacing_tolerance, and total or frozen spectral_derivative. slow_velocity_mute accepts stop_velocity, pass_velocity, reject_slow or keep_slow mode, spacing_tolerance, and the same spectral_derivative policy. Receiver-wavenumber hooks require a regularly sampled dense cable and use trace_pair stage. For taper hooks, absolute d0/d1 values may carry physical units via a shared units field or per-value {value, units} objects; domain_fraction d0/d1 values are dimensionless fractions of the largest domain extent. Acquisition-spacing scales are unsupported.

preprocessConfig.description: Preprocessing hook list or object. An explicit empty array disables default legacy preprocessing at that scope.

norm.description: Deprecated legacy field. Use objective.kind; absent objective configuration preserves the legacy L2 objective.

objective_terms.description: Ordered task-local objective terms. Term ids must be unique and each receiver_group must name one configured receiver group.

preprocess.description: Default preprocessing hooks for all misfit receiver groups.

IC.description: Imaging-condition kind. Built-ins include pressure, velocity, up_down, energy, energy:acoustic, energy:elastic, fwi, fwi:acoustic, fwi:acoustic_up_down, and fwi:elastic; custom registry entries are allowed.

property.description: Material property targeted by property-sensitive imaging conditions such as FWI. Elastic rho derivatives hold the other coordinates of the material parameter space fixed and include both inertial and constitutive contributions where applicable.

sources.description: Optional one-based encoded source/RHS ids included in this image.

preprocess.description: Reserved for future image-stage preprocessing hook objects. Runtime v1 rejects non-empty image-local preprocess blocks.

name.description: Image manager name and output-file stem.

data_path.description: Base path for observed data used by misfit receiver groups.

save_path.description: Directory for imaging field and image products. Defaults to ResultPath/imaging.

norm.description: Deprecated legacy field. Configure misfit.objective explicitly.

post_process.description: Request a registered reconstruction kernel. Currently supported only when every active physics is acoustic or elastic DPG; otherwise initialization warns once and disables post-processing for the problem.

field_retention.description: Explicit durable wavefield policy. When present, overrides the legacy keep_forward and keep_adjoint flags. Disposable fields are stored in a separate transient container and removed as a whole.

field_scratch_path.description: Optional shared-filesystem directory for disposable fields<task>.transient.h5 containers. Relative paths are resolved below ProjectPath; the imaging save path is the default.

max_task_field_storage_gib.description: Per-task upper bound in GiB for newly allocated durable plus transient image-grid field chunks. Zero disables the bound.

field_storage_limit_action.description: Whether a field-storage estimate above max_task_field_storage_gib fails initialization or emits a warning.

keep_unstacked.description: Expand images without an explicit sources selector into one image per encoded RHS, named source_01_<name>, source_02_<name>, etc. Explicit sources selections are unchanged. Frequency stacking and smoothing retain these independent image names.

born_traces_only.description: For a Born workflow, stop after writing incremental receiver traces instead of storing incremental wavefields, solving the incremental adjoint, and writing an incremental image.

direction.description: Read-only HDF5 Cartesian direction file consumed by incremental imaging workflows. The file contains image/<image-name> datasets in the same solver image/value-frame format as an aggregate image file.

zero_direction.description: Explicitly use a zero Cartesian direction. For lsrtm_gradient exactly one of direction or zero_direction=true is required.

gauss_newton.description: For a Born workflow, drive the incremental adjoint directly from the linearized receiver residual. The explicit lsrtm_gradient workflow enables this behavior automatically and includes the background and observed traces in that residual.

sync_local_shards.description: Drain closed rank-local transient wavefield shards before the next solver stage and discard clean forward-shard cache pages.

grid.description: Regular image/output grid consumed by read_grid.

preprocess.description: Workflow-level preprocessing hooks applied to compatible imaging owners and stages.

Smoothing.description: Optional FEM smoothing applied while stacking Cartesian image shards.

operation.description: riesz preserves the legacy smoothing map; proximal evaluates a bounded diagonal-metric TV/TGV proximal operator.

lambda.description: Fraction of the local P wavelength used as the smoothing length.

alpha.description: Optional direct Tikhonov/TV H1 coefficient; invalid for TGV.

beta.description: Optional direct TV shrinkage weight; invalid for TGV.

alpha1.description: Optional direct first-order TGV weight. Must be supplied with alpha2.

alpha2.description: Optional direct symmetric-gradient TGV weight. Must be supplied with alpha1.

tgv_ratio.description: Dimensionless TGV balance used by alpha2=tgv_ratio*alpha1^2.

derivative_order.description: Image smoothing uses mixed first-order H1 fields and never differentiates the primary image twice.

tau.description: Proximal step multiplying the TV or TGV regularizer.

fidelity.description: Positive scalar or positive Cartesian grid-diagonal proximal fidelity D.

normalize_illumination.description: Legacy alias: true selects cross illumination normalization and false selects none. Ignored when illumination_normalization is present.

illumination_normalization.description: Illumination policy applied before smoothing. source (alias linear) divides by the baseline forward-illumination diagonal and is linear in the adjoint or Born data; cross (alias nonlinear) also uses adjoint illumination and is nonlinear.
